Name: Floral Liqueurs
Author: Tithrandel
Description:
[center][size=5][b][u]Floral Liqueurs[/u][/b][/size]
[/center][size=3][u]What's this?[/u][/size]
My first mod ! Made of the frustration that [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3609]Quality Products[/url] was discontinued and that flower mead just didn't match my expectations.
I didn't make a mod on mead though... too much difficulty since I can't make a mod from scratch. So I used [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url] to fulfill my floral needs.
This mod adds a drink for each and every flower in the game, made by just dropping the flower in a keg.
Works like mead, but with flowers instead of honey, and colorful bottles for each drink.

[size=3][u]What do you need?[/u][/size]
For the basics:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url] 
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4970]Producer Framework Mod[/url]﻿
[/list]
If you want to age your drinks:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2642]Custom Cask Mod[/url]﻿
[/list]
[size=3][u]What if you want more?[/u][/size]
I made drinks for the flowers in the mods I usually play with:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1598]PPJA - Fruits and Vegies[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2028]PPJA - Mizu's Flower[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1671]PPJA - More Trees[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2075]PPJA - Farmer to Florist[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3568]Lucky Clover[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3581]Six Plantable Crops in Winter[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7110]Lumisteria Flowers and Crops[/url]﻿
[/list]
I recommend using my mod along these (otherwise you'll only get six drinks, kinda sad no? And the mods listed are so good I don't even wanna play Vanilla anymore)

[u][size=3]What next?[/size][/u]
[list]
[*]Add custom descriptions to each drink
[*]Add custom likes/dislikes for better gifts (for now they all have the same pattern)
[*]Add custom effects (no buffing with those for now)
[*]Add translations (only supports english and french)
[*]Add [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8416]Expanded Casks[/url]﻿ support
[*]Add other mod support?
[/list]

Downloads.Description:
First update!
Added custom description and likes/dislikes for all Vanilla liqueurs.
Added Lumisteria Flowers and Crops compatibility (17 new liqueurs).
Don't forget to delete the former file before unzipping this one in the mod directory.
